products.name: AURA Pro Active Noise-Cancelling Headphones
products.tagline: Custom 40mm beryllium drivers with 38-hour battery and spatial audio.
products.description: Engineered for uncompromising audiophiles. The AURA Pro features custom 40mm beryllium acoustic transducers, adaptive active noise cancellation with 4-mic beamforming arrays, and premium lambskin memory foam ear cushions.
products.detailedDescription: The AURA Pro is the culmination of three years of acoustic engineering. Housed in a precision CNC-machined aerospace aluminum chassis, each acoustic chamber is individually tuned to eliminate internal resonance. Enjoy high-resolution LDAC and aptX Adaptive codecs alongside our proprietary spatial audio algorithm that places you right at the center of the recording studio.

reviews.title: Studio quality in an everyday form factor
reviews.comment: The instrument separation on these is breathtaking. Far superior clarity compared to the Sony WH-1000XM5 and AirPods Max. The lambskin cushions remain comfortable even after 8 hours at my desk.

reviews.title: Build quality is second to none
reviews.comment: Tactile buttons instead of frustrating touch swipes! The ANC silences cafe chatter completely without any ear pressure sensation.

products.name: AURA Horizon Automatic Chronograph
products.tagline: Swiss mechanical movement, sapphire crystal, and vegetable-tanned Italian bridle leather.
products.description: An understated masterpiece of horology. Featuring a 28,800 bph automatic caliber with a 42-hour power reserve, double-domed anti-reflective sapphire crystal, and an exhibition caseback showcasing Geneva stripes.
products.detailedDescription: Designed in Copenhagen and assembled by master watchmakers, the Horizon Chronograph pairs minimalist mid-century Bauhaus symmetry with rigorous mechanical resilience. Water resistant to 10 ATM (100 meters), it seamlessly transitions from morning laps to black-tie galas.

reviews.title: Heirloom level craftsmanship
reviews.comment: Wears noticeably smaller and thinner than other automatic chronographs. The dial legibility in low light with the Swiss Super-LumiNova is magnificent.

products.name: Komorebi Tailored Merino Wool Coat
products.tagline: 100% heavyweight 620gsm virgin Merino wool with structured drape.
products.description: Cut from sustainably sourced virgin Australian Merino wool, the Komorebi Coat offers architectural drape with extraordinary thermal regulation and wind resistance. Finished with genuine horn buttons and cupro silk lining.
products.detailedDescription: The coat that defines cold-weather sophistication. Crafted in a family-owned sartorial atelier, the floating horsehair canvas chest piece ensures the lapel rolls naturally and adapts to your form over time. Features two interior welt pockets sized specifically for passports and modern smartphones.

reviews.title: Perfect weight and modern silhouette
reviews.comment: Substantial weight that drapes effortlessly without feeling like an armored suit. Kept me warm in 25°F Chicago wind with just a knit sweater underneath.

products.name: Verve Custom Machined Aluminum Mechanical Keyboard
products.tagline: Gasket-mounted CNC anodized brass chassis with lubed linear switches.
products.description: The definitive typing experience. Engineered with a multi-layered poron acoustic dampening stack, hot-swappable PCB, and pre-lubricated custom linear switches on an anodized brass weight plate.
products.detailedDescription: Every keystroke delivers a deep, resonant, marbly acoustic profile. Featuring south-facing per-key RGB backlighting with diffuser bars, programmable rotary encoder for media scrub and volume, and seamless tri-mode connectivity (2.4GHz low latency, Bluetooth 5.2 multi-device, and braided USB-C).

specs.label: Mounting Style
specs.value: Double Gasket Mount with Poron Isolators

reviews.title: Sounds like smooth raindrops on marble
reviews.comment: Out of the box, this feels like an expensive custom build that took weeks of modding. The knob is heavy aluminum and incredibly satisfying.

products.name: Kanso Handcrafted Ceramic Pour-Over & Kettle Set
products.tagline: Artisanal stoneware dripper, double-walled carafe, and precision gooseneck kettle.
products.description: Transform your morning coffee into a sensory ritual. Crafted by generational ceramicists using mineral-rich coarse terracotta clay, paired with a temperature-controlled matte stainless steel gooseneck kettle.
products.detailedDescription: The geometric spiral ribs on the interior of the dripper facilitate optimal water saturation and degassing flow rate. The matching double-walled server preserves brewing temperatures for up to 45 minutes without reheating, protecting subtle floral and fruit tasting notes.

reviews.title: Elevated my morning completely
reviews.comment: Not only does it brew an exceptionally clean cup with zero bitterness, it looks like a sculpture on my countertop.

products.name: Atelier Relaxed French Linen Shirt
products.tagline: Pre-washed Normandy flax with mother-of-pearl buttons.
products.description: Spun from sustainably harvested certified French flax, this relaxed button-down is garment-washed for broken-in softness from day one. Naturally breathable, hypoallergenic, and designed for effortless layering.
products.detailedDescription: Tailored with a soft camp collar and a curved split hem, the Atelier shirt strikes the balance between nonchalant resort elegance and crisp metropolitan dress. Features single-needle stitching throughout and reinforced seam gussets.

reviews.title: The holy grail linen shirt
reviews.comment: Has that effortless, soft drape without feeling scratchy like cheaper linen. Gets softer with every single wash.

products.name: Lugano Full-Grain Leather Weekender Duffel
products.tagline: Vegetable-tanned Tuscan vachetta leather with solid brass YKK Excella hardware.
products.description: Hand-burnished in Santa Croce sull’Arno, Italy. The Lugano Duffel is built to accompany you for decades of travel, developing a rich amber patina that tells the story of every journey.
products.detailedDescription: Includes an insulated separate shoe compartment lined in antimicrobial nylon, a padded 16” laptop compartment with magnetic closure, and a removable padded ergonomic shoulder strap. Fits comfortably in domestic and international airline overhead bins.

specs.label: Hardware
specs.value: Solid Japanese Brass Hardware with YKK Excella Zippers

reviews.title: The compliments never stop
reviews.comment: Smells like authentic high-end leather the second you unbox it. The shoe compartment keeps everything neatly separated and clean.

products.name: Halo Nordic Dimmable Ambient Table Lamp
products.tagline: Mouth-blown opal glass orb resting in a solid travertine marble pedestal.
products.description: A striking interplay of geometric form and atmospheric illumination. Emits a soothing 2200K–2700K warm incandescent glow via stepless capacitive touch dimming.
products.detailedDescription: The porous natural travertine stone base is individually cut and sealed, ensuring no two lamps have the exact same vein pattern. Powered by an internal rechargeable 5000mAh battery for 20 hours of cord-free placement or permanent USB-C tabletop power.

reviews.title: Pure architectural poetry
reviews.comment: The soft glow transforms our living room every evening. Cordless freedom means we can move it out to the patio for dinner parties too.

products.name: Monolith Carbon Desktop Studio Monitors (Pair)
products.tagline: Custom carbon fiber woofers with bi-amped Class-D amplification and optical inputs.
products.description: Pristine acoustic reproduction for discerning music producers and home offices. Delivers flat studio-reference frequency response with tight, fast low-end transient response.
products.detailedDescription: Featuring 4.5-inch woven carbon fiber woofers paired with 1-inch silk dome tweeters, driven by 120W of dedicated digital amplification. Features Bluetooth 5.0 with aptX HD, RCA analog line inputs, and optical digital TOSLINK.

reviews.title: Unbelievable detail and imaging
reviews.comment: Replaced a pair of bulky studio monitors. These take up half the footprint while delivering cleaner vocal separation and faster bass.

products.name: Santal & Hinoki Botanical Wax Candle (300g)
products.tagline: Hand-poured coconut apricot wax with smoked Australian sandalwood and cedarwood.
products.description: Slow-burning sensory warmth. Infused with natural essential oils of aged sandalwood, Japanese hinoki cypress, cardamom spice, and Tuscan orris root.
products.detailedDescription: Poured in a matte charcoal refractory vessel that can be repurposed as a succulent planter or desk pen cup after the candle burns down. Clean burning wood wick creates a subtle soothing campfire crackle.

reviews.title: Signature scent of our home now
reviews.comment: Not sickeningly sweet like commercial candles. Grounding, rich, and fills our entire open-concept kitchen without being overpowering.

products.name: Kyoto Brushed Mongolian Cashmere Scarf
products.tagline: Grade-A 100% organic long-fiber cashmere with ripple water finish.
products.description: Woven on traditional wooden shuttle looms in northern Italy using combed pure Mongolian cashmere fibers. Impossibly soft against the neck with generous dimensions for versatile styling.
products.detailedDescription: Treated with a natural thistle teasel ripple process that raises the fibers to a shimmering cloud-like luster. Finished with delicate hand-twisted fringe details.

specs.label: Care
specs.value: Hand wash cool with wool wash or dry clean

reviews.title: Feels like wearing a warm cloud
reviews.comment: Zero itchiness, absolutely featherlight yet keeps the frigid morning wind out. Beautiful gift packaging as well.

products.name: Veloce Ultralight Titanium Polarized Sunglasses
products.tagline: Japanese aerospace titanium wireframe with Zeiss polarized antireflective lenses.
products.description: Weighing just 16 grams, the Veloce sunglasses combine featherweight resilience with distortion-free optical clarity. Custom screwless hinge mechanism engineered to withstand over 20,000 cycles.
products.detailedDescription: Featuring Carl Zeiss CR-39 polarized lenses with anti-reflective hydrophobic and oleophobic internal coatings. Ceramic hypoallergenic nose pads ensure seamless comfort throughout all-day wear.

reviews.title: You literally forget you have them on
reviews.comment: No nose fatigue even after 6-hour road trips. The lenses cut road glare completely with zero color distortion.

questions.question: Does this come with a 3.5mm analog audio cable for zero latency studio monitoring?
questions.answer: Yes, the AURA Pro includes both a custom braided 3.5mm oxygen-free copper cable and a USB-C lossless digital DAC cable in the luxury travel case.

questions.question: What is the replacement and warranty policy if I need ear cushion replacements in the future?
questions.answer: We provide a 2-Year Comprehensive Atelier Warranty. Magnetic replacement ear cushions in genuine lambskin or vegan protein leather can be ordered directly from customer care.

questions.question: Is the movement automatic mechanical or quartz battery operated?
questions.answer: The Horizon Chronograph features a true Swiss-engineered mechanical automatic caliber with 28,800 vibrations per hour and 42-hour power reserve. No batteries needed.

questions.question: What is the recommended sizing for wearing over thick winter knitwear?
questions.answer: The coat is designed with a relaxed, tailored drape. We recommend choosing your standard size for comfortable layering over heavy knits and blazers.

supportTickets.subject: Request for scheduled Saturday morning delivery slot

messages.message: Could you please confirm if the package can be delivered specifically between 10 AM and 1 PM this Saturday at my residence?
Hello Alex Morgan, we have instructed Blue Dart Apex priority dispatch for your preferred Saturday 10 AM - 1 PM delivery window. The driver will contact your on-file number 30 minutes prior.

faqs.question: How fast is insured delivery and which carriers are used?
faqs.answer: All orders are dispatched via temperature-controlled Blue Dart Apex and DHL Express with insured tracking. Delivery takes 1-2 business days for metropolitan centers and 2-4 business days for all other Indian pin codes.

faqs.question: What is the 30-day Atelier trial and return process?
faqs.answer: We offer an unconditional 30-day complimentary return or replacement policy. You can request a return directly from your dashboard; our concierge will schedule a white-glove pickup from your doorstep.

faqs.question: How is authenticity guaranteed for mechanical chronographs and acoustics?
faqs.answer: Every AURA creation arrives with a serialized certificate of origin, individual calibration test sheet, and a tamper-evident NFC holographic seal registered in our atelier archive.

faqs.question: Can I claim GST input tax credit for business purchases?
faqs.answer: Yes. Enter your company GSTIN during checkout, and our system will automatically generate a GST-compliant tax invoice (Original for Recipient) with itemized CGST and SGST.

faqs.question: Which payment methods are supported and is Cash on Delivery available?
faqs.answer: We support all major Visa, Mastercard, RuPay cards, UPI, Net Banking, and zero-cost EMI through our secure Stripe & RBI-compliant gateway. Cash on Delivery (COD) is available on orders up to ₹25,000.
